id: # The terrain kinds of terrain-and-map.md (manual p.17). One row for each kind of hex of the map.

# cost_*: the movement points that a unit of the movement class spends to enter the hex; 0 = it cannot enter. The spec gives only the order (main road low; swamp and plank road high): every number is assumed (Q-167).
# needs_technique: the technique key that a unit needs to enter (small path, shallows: 難所行軍), or - (documented).

# loss_percent: soldiers lost when the unit enters (plank road, poison spring; documented that soldiers are lost, the percent is assumed). loss_waiver_technique and loss_waiver_skill stop the loss (難所行軍, 踏破 #7, 解毒 #9; a skill is its number in skills.md).
# buildable: a facility can stand on it. tactics: the classes whose tactics work on it (documented). tile: the colour of the placeholder atlas. level: the height of the placeholder map.
